description: Open (or close) the Qiksy side panel on a tab and optionally jump to a tab: 'forms' | 'findings' | 'tour' | 'tools' | 'history' | 'roles'. Controls Qiksy's OWN UI only — it does not touch the page under test. Set open:false to close.

open.description: true to open, false to close

tabId.description: Target tab (from qa_tabs); omit for the active tab

name: qa_open_panel
